activity.notes: Galois published mathematical work in 1829–1830, submitted further memoirs on solvability of polynomial equations by radicals in 1831, and died on 31 May 1832. This 1829–1832 representative scholarly interval records his mathematics and early group theory; it does not conflate political activism with mathematical activity.
